summary: The test-only st3-fixture binary runs its reconciler at the fastest supported pass cap (600 a minute) when the config sets none, so integration tests stop waiting out pass spacing; st keeps its default of 30, and a cap the config names is kept as before.

replay.detail: No claim, replay or projection change.

schema.detail: No storage or schema change; config.toml reads and writes the same key.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change; an existing max_passes_per_minute is honored unchanged.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines: the installed binary's default stays 30.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit to run the fixture at 30 passes a minute again.
